WITH c AS (
    SELECT cik
    FROM semantic.companies
    WHERE TRIM(split_part(tickers, ';', 1)) = 'COST'
),
r AS (
    SELECT f.fiscal_year, f.value
    FROM semantic.financials f
    JOIN c ON f.cik = c.cik
    WHERE f.metric_id = 'revenue'
      AND f.fiscal_period = 'FY'
      AND f.fiscal_year IN (2024, 2025)
)
SELECT ROUND(
    (MAX(CASE WHEN fiscal_year = 2025 THEN value END)
     - MAX(CASE WHEN fiscal_year = 2024 THEN value END))
    / MAX(CASE WHEN fiscal_year = 2024 THEN value END) * 100,
    2) AS revenue_pct_change
FROM r

SELECT ROUND((r2.value - r1.value) / r1.value * 100, 2) AS revenue_pct_change
FROM semantic.financials r1
JOIN semantic.financials r2
  ON r2.cik = r1.cik
 AND r2.metric_id = 'revenue'
 AND r2.fiscal_period = 'FY'
 AND r2.fiscal_year = 2019
JOIN semantic.companies c
  ON c.cik = r1.cik
WHERE split_part(c.tickers, ';', 1) = 'HD'
  AND r1.metric_id = 'revenue'
  AND r1.fiscal_period = 'FY'
  AND r1.fiscal_year = 2018

WITH c AS (
  SELECT cik
  FROM semantic.companies
  WHERE split_part(tickers, ';', 1) = 'CVX'
),
r AS (
  SELECT f.fiscal_year, f.value
  FROM semantic.financials f
  JOIN c ON f.cik = c.cik
  WHERE f.metric_id = 'revenue'
    AND f.fiscal_period = 'FY'
    AND f.fiscal_year IN (2024, 2025)
)
SELECT
  (MAX(CASE WHEN fiscal_year = 2025 THEN value END)
   - MAX(CASE WHEN fiscal_year = 2024 THEN value END))
  / MAX(CASE WHEN fiscal_year = 2024 THEN value END) * 100 AS revenue_pct_change
FROM r

SELECT ROUND((r20.value - r19.value) / r19.value * 100, 2) AS revenue_pct_change
FROM semantic.companies c
JOIN semantic.financials r19
  ON r19.cik = c.cik
 AND r19.metric_id = 'revenue'
 AND r19.fiscal_year = 2019
 AND r19.fiscal_period = 'FY'
JOIN semantic.financials r20
  ON r20.cik = c.cik
 AND r20.metric_id = 'revenue'
 AND r20.fiscal_year = 2020
 AND r20.fiscal_period = 'FY'
WHERE split_part(c.tickers, ';', 1) = 'GS'

WITH co AS (
  SELECT cik
  FROM semantic.companies
  WHERE split_part(tickers, ';', 1) = 'WMT'
),
rev AS (
  SELECT f.fiscal_year, f.value
  FROM semantic.financials f
  JOIN co ON f.cik = co.cik
  WHERE f.metric_id = 'revenue'
    AND f.fiscal_period = 'FY'
    AND f.fiscal_year IN (2020, 2021)
)
SELECT
  (MAX(CASE WHEN fiscal_year = 2021 THEN value END)
   - MAX(CASE WHEN fiscal_year = 2020 THEN value END))
  / MAX(CASE WHEN fiscal_year = 2020 THEN value END) * 100 AS revenue_pct_change
FROM rev

WITH c AS (
  SELECT cik
  FROM semantic.companies
  WHERE TRIM(SPLIT_PART(tickers, ';', 1)) = 'IBM'
)
SELECT (b.value - a.value) / a.value * 100 AS revenue_pct_change
FROM semantic.financials a
JOIN semantic.financials b
  ON b.cik = a.cik
 AND b.metric_id = a.metric_id
 AND b.fiscal_period = 'FY'
 AND b.fiscal_year = 2023
WHERE a.cik = (SELECT cik FROM c)
  AND a.metric_id = 'revenue'
  AND a.fiscal_period = 'FY'
  AND a.fiscal_year = 2022

SELECT

FROM semantic.financials r20
JOIN semantic.financials r21

    SELECT cik
    FROM semantic.companies
    WHERE trim(split_part(tickers, ';', 1)) = 'BAC'
)
SELECT (r2.value - r1.value) / r1.value * 100 AS revenue_pct_change
FROM semantic.financials r1
JOIN semantic.financials r2
  ON r2.cik = r1.cik
 AND r2.metric_id = r1.metric_id
 AND r2.fiscal_period = 'FY'

)
SELECT ROUND((r18.value - r17.value) / r17.value * 100, 2) AS revenue_pct_change
FROM semantic.financials r17
JOIN semantic.financials r18

 AND r18.metric_id = 'revenue'
 AND r18.fiscal_year = 2018
 AND r18.fiscal_period = 'FY'
WHERE r17.cik = (SELECT cik FROM unh)

FROM semantic.financials AS f
WHERE f.metric_id = 'net_income'
  AND f.fiscal_year = 2023
  AND f.fiscal_period = 'FY'

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT cik) AS companies_with_restated_fy2022_revenue
FROM semantic.financials_history
WHERE metric_id = 'revenue'
  AND fiscal_year = 2022
  AND fiscal_period = 'FY'
  AND is_restatement = TRUE

WITH rev AS (
    SELECT cik, value AS revenue
    FROM semantic.financials
    WHERE metric_id = 'revenue'
      AND fiscal_year = 2024
      AND fiscal_period = 'FY'
      AND value > 50000000000
),
rd AS (
    SELECT cik, value AS rnd
    FROM semantic.financials
    WHERE metric_id = 'research_and_development'
      AND fiscal_year = 2024
      AND fiscal_period = 'FY'
)
SELECT split_part(c.tickers, ';', 1) AS ticker
FROM rev
JOIN rd USING (cik)
JOIN semantic.companies c USING (cik)
ORDER BY rd.rnd / rev.revenue DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT split_part(c.tickers, ';', 1) AS ticker,
       f.value AS net_margin
FROM semantic.financials f
JOIN semantic.financials r
  ON r.cik = f.cik
 AND r.metric_id = 'revenue'
 AND r.fiscal_year = 2024
 AND r.fiscal_period = 'FY'
JOIN semantic.companies c
  ON c.cik = f.cik
WHERE f.metric_id = 'net_margin'
  AND f.fiscal_year = 2024
  AND f.fiscal_period = 'FY'
  AND f.value IS NOT NULL
  AND r.value > 10000000000
ORDER BY f.value ASC
LIMIT 1

SELECT f.value AS diluted_eps_fy2022
FROM semantic.financials f
JOIN semantic.companies c ON f.cik = c.cik
WHERE split_part(c.tickers, ';', 1) = 'AAPL'
  AND f.metric_id = 'eps_diluted'
  AND f.fiscal_year = 2022
  AND f.fiscal_period = 'FY'

SELECT h.value
FROM semantic.financials_history h
JOIN semantic.companies c
  ON h.cik = c.cik
WHERE trim(string_split(c.tickers, ';')[1]) = 'IBM'
  AND h.metric_id = 'revenue'
  AND h.fiscal_period = 'FY'
  AND h.fiscal_year = 2019
  AND h.version_no = 1

SELECT f.value
FROM semantic.financials_history f
JOIN semantic.companies c
  ON f.cik = c.cik
WHERE TRIM(split_part(c.tickers, ';', 1)) = 'IBM'
  AND f.metric_id = 'revenue'
  AND f.fiscal_year = 2019
  AND f.fiscal_period = 'FY'
  AND f.valid_to IS NULL

SELECT SUM(f.value) AS combined_revenue_usd
FROM semantic.financials f
JOIN semantic.companies c
  ON c.cik = f.cik
WHERE split_part(c.tickers, ';', 1) IN ('CVX', 'XOM')
  AND f.metric_id = 'revenue'
  AND f.fiscal_year = 2022
  AND f.fiscal_period = 'FY'

SELECT f.value AS free_cash_flow_usd
FROM semantic.financials f
JOIN semantic.companies c
  ON f.cik = c.cik
WHERE upper(trim(split_part(c.tickers, ';', 1))) = 'NFLX'
  AND f.metric_id = 'free_cash_flow'
  AND f.fiscal_year = 2021
  AND f.fiscal_period = 'FY'

SELECT
  split_part(c.tickers, ';', 1) AS ticker,
  f.value AS total_assets
FROM semantic.financials f
JOIN semantic.companies c
  ON f.cik = c.cik
WHERE c.gics_sector = 'Health Care'
  AND f.metric_id = 'total_assets'
  AND f.fiscal_year = 2024
  AND f.fiscal_period = 'FY'
ORDER BY f.value DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 1

SELECT f.value * 100 AS gross_margin_pct
FROM semantic.financials f
JOIN semantic.companies c ON c.cik = f.cik
WHERE TRIM(split_part(c.tickers, ';', 1)) = 'AMD'
  AND f.metric_id = 'gross_margin'
  AND f.fiscal_year = 2023
  AND f.fiscal_period = 'FY'

SELECT f.fiscal_year
FROM semantic.financials f
JOIN semantic.companies c ON c.cik = f.cik
WHERE list_contains(string_split(c.tickers, ';'), 'BA')
  AND f.metric_id = 'net_income'
  AND f.fiscal_period = 'FY'
  AND f.fiscal_year BETWEEN 2015 AND 2025
ORDER BY f.value ASC
LIMIT 1

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT cik) AS companies_over_100b_revenue_fy2024
FROM semantic.financials
WHERE metric_id = 'revenue'
  AND fiscal_year = 2024
  AND fiscal_period = 'FY'
  AND value > 100000000000

SELECT f.value AS revenue_ytd_q2_fy2024_usd
FROM semantic.financials f
JOIN semantic.companies c
  ON f.cik = c.cik
WHERE trim(split_part(c.tickers, ';', 1)) = 'UNH'
  AND f.metric_id = 'revenue'
  AND f.fiscal_year = 2024
  AND f.fiscal_period = 'Q2_YTD'

with c as (
  select cik
  from semantic.companies
  where split_part(tickers, ';', 1) = 'ORCL'
)
select 100.0
       * max(case when f.metric_id = 'total_liabilities' then f.value end)
       / max(case when f.metric_id = 'total_assets' then f.value end) as liabilities_to_assets_pct
from semantic.financials f
join c on f.cik = c.cik
where f.fiscal_year = 2024
  and f.fiscal_period = 'FY'
  and f.metric_id in ('total_liabilities', 'total_assets')

WITH c AS (
  SELECT cik
  FROM semantic.companies
  WHERE split_part(tickers, ';', 1) = 'PFE'
),
r AS (
  SELECT f.fiscal_year, f.value
  FROM semantic.financials f
  JOIN c ON f.cik = c.cik
  WHERE f.metric_id = 'revenue'
    AND f.fiscal_period = 'FY'
    AND f.fiscal_year IN (2022, 2023)
)
SELECT
  (MAX(CASE WHEN fiscal_year = 2023 THEN value END)
   - MAX(CASE WHEN fiscal_year = 2022 THEN value END))
  / MAX(CASE WHEN fiscal_year = 2022 THEN value END) * 100 AS revenue_growth_pct
FROM r

WITH banks AS (
    SELECT cik
    FROM semantic.companies
    WHERE gics_sub_industry ILIKE '%Banks%'
),
top4 AS (
    SELECT f.cik, f.value AS total_assets
    FROM semantic.financials f
    JOIN banks b ON b.cik = f.cik
    WHERE f.metric_id = 'total_assets'
      AND f.fiscal_year = 2024
      AND f.fiscal_period = 'FY'
    ORDER BY f.value DESC
    LIMIT 4
)
SELECT SUM(ni.value) AS combined_fy2024_net_income_usd
FROM top4 t
JOIN semantic.financials ni
  ON ni.cik = t.cik
 AND ni.metric_id = 'net_income'
 AND ni.fiscal_year = 2024
 AND ni.fiscal_period = 'FY'

SELECT f.value AS revenue_usd
FROM semantic.financials f
JOIN semantic.companies c
  ON f.cik = c.cik
WHERE split_part(c.tickers, ';', 1) = 'NKE'
  AND f.metric_id = 'revenue'
  AND f.fiscal_year = 2024
  AND f.fiscal_period = 'FY'

SELECT COUNT(*) AS sectors_above_200b
FROM (
    SELECT c.gics_sector, SUM(f.value) AS total_net_income
    FROM semantic.financials f
    JOIN semantic.companies c ON f.cik = c.cik
    WHERE f.metric_id = 'net_income'
      AND f.fiscal_period = 'FY'
      AND f.fiscal_year = 2024
      AND c.gics_sector IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY c.gics_sector
) t
WHERE t.total_net_income > 200000000000
